summary.text: Judy Lee is a Republican state senator from District 13 in West Fargo who took office in 1994 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired real estate broker, she chairs the Senate Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Judy Lee earned a B.S. in medical technology from the University of North Dakota in 1964.
She worked as a medical technician from 1964 to 1975 and as a real estate broker from 1975 to 2002.
Lee assumed office in the North Dakota Senate in 1994 and served as president pro tempore in 2007.
Her legislative biography lists service on the board of the Vocational Training Center, the advisory board of the Children's Advocacy Center of North Dakota, and the board of Eventide Senior Living.
In 2025 she chairs the Senate Human Services Committee and serves on the State and Local Government Committee.
